answer: I read the default calibration of garnet with get_calibration_quality_metrics. I compared all 28 CZ IRB fidelities under metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf. The best pair is QB12 and QB11. Its CZ IRB fidelity is 0.998693, with an uncertainty of 0.00035. The next best pair is QB12 and QB7 at 0.998016. I ran a Bell circuit (H, then CX, then measure both) on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The transpiler layout put the circuit on QB12 (index 11) and QB11 (index 10), and both qubits were measured. Job 01a15f9f-5c8f-76d8-abd8-f1a23470805c finished with status DONE. The counts are 00: 25, 01: 26, 10: 25, 11: 24. The counts are spread evenly over all four outcomes. This is expected because the mock backend returns random results. It is not a real Bell-state result. Scripts are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-22 (cal.py, cal2.py, run.py, cal.pkl).
